purpose: Planning-only strategy for consolidating numbered Flash UI variants into canonical /sites group folders while preserving access to every variant.
variantHubRequirements: Show concept title and short description.
List every variant with an Open button.
Show recommended primary variant when known.
Preserve direct links to every variant.
Do not hide variants from internal command mode.

useExistingMetadata.note: asset-groups.json already identifies many variant sets. Batch 20 should use that file as the source of truth for group candidates, then create canonical hub folders only for approved groups.

registryMigrationStrategy.shortTerm: Suppress duplicate root entries where /sites copy exists.
registryMigrationStrategy.mediumTerm: Create group-card registry entries that point to canonical variant hub pages.
registryMigrationStrategy.longTerm: Render variants from group metadata or a dedicated asset-variants file.

executionPlanForBatch20: Create canonical folder for each approved variant set.
Move existing /sites variant folders into canonical variant-N subfolders.
Generate lightweight hub index.html for each canonical folder.
Update registry/grouping metadata so cards open hubs and preserve variant links.
Smoke test hub URLs and direct variant URLs.
